sources.scope: Direct species account in a SANBI-published regional flora; claims below are paraphrased and retain this account's regional scope.

claims.text: The account describes an erect, robust resprouting or reseeding shrub reaching 1.8 m. Its three-foliolate leaves have linear-oblanceolate leaflets that may be terete or somewhat flattened, usually strongly revolute margins and soft hairs; yellow flowers and bracts clasping the calyx base are noted.
claims.locator: Printed p. 549, individual Cyclopia bowieana account; SANBI e-Flora v1.36 Morphology row 5040 (source identifier 14286.0)
claims.placeTimeScope: Regional flora account; adult plant form as stated in the 2012 account; no sex-specific or population sample is given.
claims.lifeStatus: Extant regional flora account; cultivation status not specified.

gaps: Developmental stages, sex-specific traits, variation, measured samples and diagnostic limits have not been reviewed.

claims.text: The species account gives a flowering period of October to December.
claims.locator: Printed p. 549, flowering months in the individual Cyclopia bowieana account
claims.placeTimeScope: Phenology stated in the 2012 South African regional account; observation locations and annual sampling are not specified.
claims.lifeStatus: Wild-status observations are not separately described.

gaps: Life-cycle stages, reproduction mode, pollination, seed development and geographic or seasonal variation have not been assessed.

claims.text: The account records mountain fynbos on upper slopes at 1,220–1,830 m as habitat.
claims.locator: Printed p. 549, habitat line in the individual Cyclopia bowieana account; SANBI e-Flora v1.36 Habitat row 28486 (source identifier 14286.0)
claims.placeTimeScope: Habitat and elevation as reported by the 2012 South African regional flora; not a complete environmental envelope.
claims.lifeStatus: Regional habitat account; management status not specified.

gaps: Resources and species interactions, habitat variation, and sampling coverage have not been reviewed.

claims.text: The printed account lists the Langeberg and Outeniqua mountains as the regional range summary.
claims.locator: Printed p. 549, distribution line in the individual Cyclopia bowieana account
claims.placeTimeScope: The printed regional range summary, abbreviated LB and SE in the source; not a global distribution or a dated locality dataset.
claims.lifeStatus: Native, introduced, cultivated and escaped status are not distinguished in this short range summary.

gaps: Locality records, coordinate precision, range date, native or introduced status, and unsampled areas have not been assessed.
No species-level phylogenetic or comparative study was assessed.
No fossil search was conducted.
No qualifying conservation assessment was reviewed.

reasons: Only four regional account topics have preliminary evidence; required scientific coverage checks across all seven facets are incomplete.
Claims have not received verified translations or independent expert review.
No systematic evidence search across literature and databases has been completed.
